R.eta_rule: one common eta minimizes task/prompt-balanced mean relative squared native output error averaged equally over three structures on DEV; exact ties choose larger eta
R.teacher: native BF16 MLP output at same post_attention_layernorm input
R.activation: actual smaller gate/up path; not sliced full activation

data.source: new deterministic synthetic English scenarios and bounded integer programs
data.split_rule: different scenario ID and disjoint factual/program seeds; no shared base scenario
data.families: retrieval facts, comparison of two values, bounded arithmetic program
data.length_policy: Variable length; whole essential prompt, no filler or truncation; caps Q1024/R512. Actual tokenizer lengths are recorded.
data.labels: A B C D; verify one-token continuation and stable prefix
data.primary_model_metric: task-balanced mean paired full-vocabulary gold next-token NLL change (candidate minus baseline)
data.baseline_floor: report every family; flag weak baseline, no heldout filtering

timing.ids: first 4 hash-ordered heldout IDs per task
timing.allocation: one model at a time; allocated/reserved and sampled whole device separately
